# Project Context: Content Hub V2 (Local-First Skill Engine)

## What V2 Is

A **local-first content production engine** that lives at `C:\Users\madhu\Claude cowork\Content Hub V2\`. Modeled on Chase AI's 10M-views workflow. Stops at the script — no automated rendering. Produces **9 deliverables per long-form** via 7 Claude Code slash-commands.

V2 is a **fork** of V1 (the SaaS-stack project at `C:\Users\madhu\Claude cowork\Content Hub\`). V1 is parked. V2 is where all active work happens. Decision logged in [[2026-04-28_V2_Pivot_Local_First_Engine]] (V1 vault).

## Current State — 2026-04-28

**Phase 0 (Cleanup) — not yet started.** V2 currently contains a full clone of V1 and needs SaaS layers stripped before build can begin.

See [[Current_Sprint]] for the live task list.

## Architecture (V2)

Two-layer skill pattern, repeated 7 times:

```
.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md   ← Claude Code entry point (/<name> trigger)
skills/<name>.py                 ← Python helper, calls model(s), writes to vault
prompts/<name>.md                ← Single source of truth for prompt text
```

**Cost-aware model routing:**
- **Ollama (local, free)** — first-draft outlines, structural work
- **Claude (paid)** — hooks, titles, voice cleanup, final-30-second polish
- **Gemini** — kept available for any tool that already wires it (research_service.py)

**Knowledge layer:**
- `notebooklm-py` (already cloned in V2) — programmatic NotebookLM access for one-shot Callaway masterclass extraction + ad-hoc deep research
- `Content-Hub-Vault/` (this vault) — human-facing workspace and skill output target
- pgvector RAG (`backend/research/rag.py`) kept available, deprioritized in v1

---

# Session — Research Options Config Gate

**Implements:** [[Research Options Config Gate]]
**Modifies:** [[FullPipelinePage]], [[main.py]], [[pipeline.py]], [[styles.css]]
**References:** [[2026-05-31_Full_Pipeline_Page]], [[brief_args]], [[researcher.py]], [[useJobStream]], [[VaultPicker]]

## Problem

On the [[Full Pipeline Page]], picking a trend **auto-ran** research with `niche: seed`. The trends `VaultPicker` was not gated on the niche being filled, so picking a trend with an empty seed launched `--niche ""` → [[researcher.py]] aborts with `--niche is required when running research`. Retry re-sent the same empty niche, looping.

## What changed

- **EDIT** `Design-doc/web/src/FullPipelinePage.jsx`
  - New `research` state (`niche, mode, targetLength, tone, audience, banned`).
  - `pickTrend` **no longer launches** — it sets `trendPath`, prefills `research.niche` from the seed, and advances to the Research step in `review` phase.
  - New `runResearch()` launches with all options threaded; blank advanced fields are omitted (→ `brief.md` defaults).
  - New `ResearchConfig` gate component: niche (editable, prefilled, **required**), mode `fast/deep` segmented toggle, target-length number, collapsed `<details>` Advanced (tone / audience / banned phrases). **Run Research** disabled until niche is non-empty — this is the bug fix.
  - `gateReady("research")` → always `true` (the config form is the gate; `ApproveGate` shows once `briefPath` exists). Retry for research routes to `runResearch`.
- **EDIT** `Design-doc/server/main.py` — `ResearcherBody` gains `target_length`, `tone`, `audience`, `banned_phrases`; route forwards them.
- **EDIT** `Design-doc/server/pipeline.py` — `run_researcher` accepts the new params and appends `--target-length / --tone / --audience / --banned-phrase` **only when set**.
- **EDIT** `Design-doc/web/src/styles.css` — appended `.fp-opt-grid`, `.fp-opt`, `.fp-seg`, `.fp-adv` reusing existing tokens.

**No `researcher.py` change** — it already accepts every flag via [[brief_args]] (`add_brief_args`). Gaps were only the web body model + subprocess wrapper.

## Decisions (confirmed with user)

- **Config gate after trend pick** (chosen over inline-at-top auto-run) — explicit "Run Research" launch, options feel per-stage, confirm before spend.
- **All three advanced fields surfaced, collapsed, optional** — blank ⇒ falls back to `brief.md`; research still runs.
- Niche is editable in the gate (prefilled from seed) so "choose niche" is honored even after the top seed input locks.

## Verification

- `npx eslint src/FullPipelinePage.jsx` → 0 errors (2 pre-existing intentional exhaustive-deps warnings).
- `npx vite build` → clean. `python -c ast.parse` on `main.py` + `pipeline.py` → OK.

## Follow-up fix — trend pick researched stale repos (researcher.py)

After the gate shipped, the first live run failed with `ValueError: No matching GitHub repo URLs found in github_trending.md` ([[researcher.py]] `run()` line ~591).

**Root cause:** `run()` used `--repos` only as a *filter against the aggregate `github_trending.md`* — it never researched a repo directly. The `04-Trends` `VaultPicker` lists all **21 persisted subfolders**, but the aggregate only holds the **13 most-recent** repos. Picking any of the 8 stale subfolders (the user picked `Manavarya09/design-extract`, niche "Design") → no slug match → raise.

**Fix (surgical, in `run()` only):** normalize each `--repos` entry to a full URL (`owner/repo` → `https://github.com/owner/repo`) and research exactly those, dropping the aggregate read + slug filter. Strictly more permissive; aligns with the flag's documented intent ("Repos to research"). `extract_urls` + `TRENDS_FILE` remain — still used by the `--list` path. Verified: all 21 subfolders (incl. the failing `design-extract`) now resolve to valid URLs. **No restart needed** — researcher runs as a fresh subprocess per job.

## Open items

- **Backend restart required** — run `uvicorn` with `--reload` (or restart) so the new `ResearcherBody` fields load; otherwise the extra flags are ignored (same stale-`main.py` gotcha noted in [[2026-05-31_Trends_UI_Fix_404_Resolved]]).
- **Live run still pending** — confirm `--target-length / --tone / --audience / --banned-phrase` actually reach the brief in a real research run.

See [[Current_Sprint]].

"""Researcher — Content gap discovery via NotebookLM.

Pipeline (one isolated notebook per repo):
  1. Read trend URLs from Content-Hub-Vault-V2/04-Trends/github_trending.md
  2. For each URL: create a notebook, add that repo as the sole source,
     run web research, verify sources via Claude, query for content gaps
  3. Compile all findings into one brief →
     Content-Hub-Vault-V2/10-Research/YYYY-MM-DD_<niche>_brief.md

Usage:
  python -m skills.researcher --list
  python -m skills.researcher --niche "AI agents" --repos owner/repo1 owner/repo2
  python -m skills.researcher --niche "AI agents" --repos owner/repo1 --mode deep
"""

import asyncio
import argparse
import json
import logging
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).parent.parent
NOTEBOOKLM_SRC = PROJECT_ROOT / "notebooklm-py" / "src"
if str(NOTEBOOKLM_SRC) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(NOTEBOOKLM_SRC))

from notebooklm import ChatGoal, NotebookLMClient
from skills.researcher_crawler import discover_primary_docs
from skills.helpers.nlm_seed import seed_questions_from_nlm
from skills.research_plan import QuestionPlan, generate_followups
from skills.brief_loader import load_brief, apply_cli_overrides
from skills.brief_args import add_brief_args
from dataclasses import dataclass

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def claude_cli(prompt: str, timeout: int = 120) -> str:
    """Call `claude -p <prompt>` and return stdout. Raises RuntimeError on failure."""
    cmd = shutil.which("claude")
    if cmd is None:
        raise RuntimeError("claude CLI not found in PATH — ensure Claude Code is installed")
    result = subprocess.run(
        [cmd, "-p", prompt],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        timeout=timeout,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"claude CLI failed (exit {result.returncode}): {result.stderr[:200]}")
    return result.stdout.strip()


def _parse_json_output(text: str) -> dict:
    """Strip markdown fences and parse JSON from Claude CLI output."""
    text = text.strip()
    if text.startswith("```"):
        lines = text.split("\n")
        end = len(lines)
        for i in range(1, len(lines)):

                end = i
                break
        text = "\n".join(lines[1:end])
    return json.loads(text)

    key_concepts: list[str]

"""Ideation — V2 Ranked Video Idea Generator from vault research notes."""

import asyncio, argparse, logging, sys, re
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")

from skills.utils.ai import polish
from skills.brief_loader import load_brief, apply_cli_overrides
from skills.brief_args import add_brief_args

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

RESEARCH_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "Content-Hub-Vault-V2" / "10-Research"
TRENDS_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "Content-Hub-Vault-V2" / "04-Trends"
VAULT_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "Content-Hub-Vault-V2" / "02-Ideas"
PROMPT_FILE = PROJECT_ROOT / "prompts" / "ideation.md"


def find_research_file(topic: str) -> Path | None:
    """Find the most recent research file matching the topic. Falls back to most recent overall."""
    if not RESEARCH_DIR.exists():
        return None

    candidates = sorted(
        [f for f in RESEARCH_DIR.glob("**/*.md") if f.name != ".gitkeep"],
        key=lambda f: f.stat().st_mtime,
        reverse=True,
    )

    if not candidates:
        return None

    # Try topic match first (case-insensitive substring)
    slug = topic.lower().replace(" ", "_")
    for f in candidates:
        if slug in f.stem.lower() or topic.lower() in f.stem.lower().replace("_", " "):
            return f

    # Fallback: most recent file
    return candidates[0]


def load_trends() -> str:
    """Load today's or most recent trending note from the vault."""
    if not TRENDS_DIR.exists():
        return ""
    md_files = sorted(
        [f for f in TRENDS_DIR.glob("*.md") if f.name != ".gitkeep"],
        key=lambda f: f.stat().st_mtime,
        reverse=True,
    )
    if not md_files:
        return ""
    content = md_files[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    # Truncate to keep token usage manageable
    return content[:3000]


def make_output_path(topic: str) -> Path:
    slug = re.sub(r"[^\w\s-]", "", topic.lower())
    slug = re.sub(r"[\s_-]+", "-", slug).strip("-")[:40]
    VAULT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return VAULT_DIR / f"{date.today().isoformat()}_{slug}.md"


async def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate ranked video ideas from vault research notes")
    parser.add_argument("--topic", required=True, help="Topic / niche to ideate on (e.g. 'AI agents')")
    parser.add_argument("--research-file", default="", help="Path to a specific research .md file (optional)")
    parser.add_argument("--no-trends", action="store_true", help="Skip loading trending context")
    add_brief_args(parser)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    brief = load_brief()
    brief = apply_cli_overrides(brief, args)

Now let me understand the bugs:

**Bug 1: State loss when switching tabs**

In `App.jsx`, the full pipeline page is rendered conditionally:
```jsx
{view === "full-pipeline" && <FullPipelinePage onBack={() => navigate("dashboard")} />}
```

When `view` changes from `"full-pipeline"` to something else, React unmounts the `FullPipelinePage` component, losing all its state. When the user navigates back, it's remounted fresh.

Fix: Render the component always but use CSS `display: none` when not active. This keeps the component mounted and preserves state.
 
**Bug 2: Research not named properly - `10-Research/2026-05-31_design_brief`**

I need to trace through `researcher.py` to find where the output path gets constructed, specifically how the niche parameter flows into the naming.

**Bug 3: Ideation not named - `02-Ideas/2026-05-31_`**

Looking at `ideation.py`, the `make_output_path` function receives `args.topic`, which comes from the `--topic` argument passed from `FullPipelinePage.jsx` when launching the ideation step.

The issue is that `topic` gets passed as `seed` from the frontend, and if the seed field is empty or just contains the niche without a specific topic, the slug generation would produce an empty string. The function creates a slug by removing special characters, converting to lowercase, and replacing whitespace with hyphens, but if the input is empty or whitespace-only, the resulting filename would just be the date with no topic suffix.

Looking at how the frontend sends this data, `seed` is the "Niche / space" input field, but for ideation it should probably use the actual research topic instead of just the niche value. The seed state appears to come from the main research input, so there's a mismatch between what's being passed and what should be used for generating meaningful output filenames. I'm tracing through the code flow to understand why the topic ends up empty. The `approveResearch` function passes `seed` as the topic, but if `seed` is blank while the user filled in `research.niche` through the config gate, there's a mismatch—the research object gets the niche value, but the ideation step receives an empty topic instead.

Two-layer skill pattern, repeated 7 times:

```
.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md   ← Claude Code entry point (/<name> trigger)
skills/<name>.py                 ← Python helper, calls model(s), writes to vault
prompts/<name>.md                ← Single source of truth for prompt text
```

**Cost-aware model routing:**
- **Ollama (local, free)** — first-draft outlines, structural work
- **Claude (paid)** — hooks, titles, voice cleanup, final-30-second polish
- **Gemini** — kept available for any tool that already wires it (research_service.py)

**Knowledge layer:**
- `notebooklm-py` (already cloned in V2) — programmatic NotebookLM access for one-shot Callaway masterclass extraction + ad-hoc deep research
- `Content-Hub-Vault/` (this vault) — human-facing workspace and skill output target
- pgvector RAG (`backend/research/rag.py`) kept available, deprioritized in v1

# Session — Full Pipeline Bug Fixes (State Loss + Ideation Name)

**Modifies:** [[FullPipelinePage]], [[App.jsx]]
**References:** [[2026-05-31_Research_Options_Config_Gate]], [[Full Pipeline Page]], [[useJobStream]]

## Bugs Fixed

### Bug 1 — State loss on tab switch

**Root cause:** `App.jsx` used `{view === "full-pipeline" && <FullPipelinePage .../>}` — the conditional render unmounts the component on every tab switch, wiping all `useState` (active step, picks, job streams).

**Fix:** Replaced with a `<div style={{ display: view === "full-pipeline" ? "" : "none" }}>` wrapper so the component stays mounted. CSS hide preserves the React fiber tree and also keeps any live `useJobStream` SSE connections alive across the switch.

**File:** `Design-doc/web/src/App.jsx` — line 100.

---

### Bug 3 — Ideation file named `2026-05-31_.md`

**Root cause:** `approveResearch` sent `topic: seed` to the ideation launcher. `seed` is the top-level "Niche / space" input. If the user left it blank and typed only in the config gate's `research.niche` field, `topic` was `""` → `make_output_path("")` → empty slug → `2026-05-31_.md`.

**Fix:** Changed `approveResearch` in `FullPipelinePage.jsx` to use `research.niche.trim() || seed.trim()`. `research.niche` is guaranteed non-empty by the time `approveResearch` is reachable (research has run and `briefPath` exists), so this is the primary value; `|| seed` is belt-and-suspenders.

**File:** `Design-doc/web/src/FullPipelinePage.jsx` — line 148.

---

## Bug 2 — Research file `2026-05-31_design_brief.md` (pending)

**Reported:** `10-Research/2026-05-31_design_brief` — user considers this "not named properly."

**Root cause candidate:** `researcher.py` line 682 builds the name from niche only (`{date}_{niche_slug}_brief.md`). With niche="design" and repo `Manavarya09/design-extract`, no repo identifier appears in the filename.

**Status:** Awaiting user clarification — the requirement is ambiguous (niche + repo slug? repo name replaces niche? something else?). No change made. See [[Current_Sprint]].

- Backend restart required to load new `ResearcherBody` fields (uvicorn `--reload`).
- Live run of `--target-length / --tone / --audience / --banned-phrase` still pending.
- Bug 2 research naming pending user answer.

"""In-memory job registry and SSE event bus.

Single-job-at-a-time constraint: while _current_job_id is set, new POST
requests should return 409. Cleared on job completion or failure.
"""

import asyncio
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional


@dataclass
class JobResult:
    result_type: str        # "file" | "bundle" | "file_set" | "brain_result"
    primary_path: str
    outputs: list           # list[str] paths for file/bundle; empty for brain_result
    data: Optional[dict] = None  # brain_result payload only


@dataclass
class Job:
    job_id: str
    stage: str
    status: str             # "running" | "completed" | "failed"
    started_at: str
    completed_at: Optional[str] = None
    result: Optional[JobResult] = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    stdout_lines: list = field(default_factory=list)
    stderr_lines: list = field(default_factory=list)
    queue: asyncio.Queue = field(default_factory=asyncio.Queue)


_jobs: dict[str, Job] = {}
_current_job_id: Optional[str] = None


def get_current_job_id() -> Optional[str]:
    return _current_job_id


def create_job(stage: str) -> Job:
    global _current_job_id
    job_id = str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]
    job = Job(
        job_id=job_id,
        stage=stage,
        status="running",
        started_at=datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
        queue=asyncio.Queue(),
    )
    _jobs[job_id] = job
    _current_job_id = job_id
    return job


def get_job(job_id: str) -> Optional[Job]:
    return _jobs.get(job_id)


def complete_job(job_id: str, result: JobResult) -> None:
    global _current_job_id
    job = _jobs.get(job_id)
    if job:
        job.status = "completed"
        job.completed_at = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        job.result = result
        job.queue.put_nowait({
            "type": "done",
            "result": {
                "result_type": result.result_type,
                "primary_path": result.primary_path,
                "outputs": result.outputs,
                "data": result.data,
            },
        })
    if _current_job_id == job_id:
        _current_job_id = None


def fail_job(job_id: str, error: str) -> None:
    global _current_job_id
    job = _jobs.get(job_id)
    if job:
        job.status = "failed"
        job.completed_at = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        job.error = error
        job.queue.put_nowait({"type": "error", "error": error})
    if _current_job_id == job_id:
        _current_job_id = None
